
Verified reference code from earlier tasks, most relevant first.

Record 1.

entry clamp_sub
params u32 u32
ret u32

Returns a - b when a >= b, else 0; never traps.

```
fn clamp_sub a uint b uint to uint
if ge a b
ret sub a b
end
ret 0
end
```

Record 2.

entry dot3
params i16 i16 i16 i16 i16 i16
ret i64

Dot product of two 3-vectors of signed 16-bit numbers, widened to 64 bits.

```
fn dot u view long 3 w view long 3 to long
s = long 0
for i uint 3
s = add s mul get u i get w i
end
ret s
end
fn dot3 a short b short c short x short y short z short to long
u = new long 3 0
w = new long 3 0
put u 0 long a
put u 1 long b
put u 2 long c
put w 0 long x
put w 1 long y
put w 2 long z
s = dot view u view w
free u
free w
ret s
end
```

Record 3.

entry sum_range
params u32 u32
ret u64

Sum of the integers from lo to hi inclusive; 0 when lo > hi.

```
fn sum_range lo uint hi uint to ulong
s = ulong 0
i = lo
while le i hi bound 100000
s = add s ulong i
i = add i 1
end
ret s
end
```
